items.label: Anji Microelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Product progress in H1 2026 (half-year report): ceria-based slurries

set.signal: Product progress in H1 2026 (half-year report): ceria-based slurries for shallow-trench isolation and dielectric polishing are fully in volume production, with several slurries using the company's self-made ceria abrasive in volume use at several customers and supply still growing; a ceria post-CMP cleaning solution reached volume sales; several advanced-node silicon nitride slurries remain in customer validation, some of which have passed and reached sales; customised tungsten slurries reached volume sales as first-choice supplier at several new customers; etchants passed validation and reached small-volume production; new-material slurries for more advanced nodes passed qualification and reached sales; copper and copper-barrier slurries kept ramping at advanced nodes.

items.reason: The report says several advanced-node silicon nitride slurries are still in customer validation and only some have passed and reached sales; the entry dropped that hedge.
items.evidence: 多款用于先进制程的氮化硅抛光液在客户端的验证持续进行，部分产品已经通过验证，实现销售。
